Example_Prompt: Summarize income, expenses and net cash flow for each month.
Expected_Correct_Behavior: Totals must match the Transactions sheet exactly.

Example_Prompt: Which expense categories account for the largest spend?
Expected_Correct_Behavior: Rank categories by total expense across the seven-month period.

Example_Prompt: Which categories exceeded budget in October 2026?
Expected_Correct_Behavior: Compare October actuals with October category budgets; show rupee and percentage variance.

Example_Prompt: Which customer invoices are outstanding or overdue?
Expected_Correct_Behavior: Show the four open invoices, their amounts and due dates; distinguish overdue from pending.

Example_Prompt: How did the cash position change from April to October?
Expected_Correct_Behavior: Use opening balance plus monthly net cash flow; ending balances must reconcile.

Example_Prompt: Give management three practical financial observations from this dataset.
Expected_Correct_Behavior: Use computed trends only; distinguish observations from recommendations.

Example_Prompt: Check for missing IDs, invalid amounts or inconsistent invoice links.
Expected_Correct_Behavior: IDs unique; amounts positive; paid invoices linked to income transactions; outstanding invoices have no receipt link.
